title: r1 N2 fix's panel-label fallback bounds are unguarded by any test
detail: The era-0/out-of-range-era/sp_index-OOB fallback paths are guarded in code but only the in-range era-3 path is pinned (warn.dem goldens). A future off-by-one in era-1 indexing or the fallback label would pass every suite.
recommended_fix: Add a unit pin calling draw_forecast_panel with era 0, era > len(eras), and an out-of-range sp_index asserting the "setpiece" fallback.

title: The r1 W2 leads legend has no automated coverage — harness captures exclude the HUD
evidence:
capture_frame :: proc(rc: ^Render_Ctx, topo: ^pp.Topology, bundles: ^pp.Bundles, flow: ^pp.Flow_State, crisis: ^pp.Crisis_State, tick: u64, era: u8) -> rl.Image {
	rl.BeginDrawing()
	rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, topo, bundles, flow, crisis, tick, {})
	rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era)
detail: T2 captures draw the world + forecast panel only; draw_hud (with the lead-time caption) is never captured or asserted, so the W2 fix's honesty claim is verified by no test and any caption drift passes silently.
recommended_fix: Either capture the HUD legend in a dedicated golden or add a string-level test asserting the caption derives from balance.json leads.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 contract pins 100% (strain, pressure, forecast, events, replay, no-flicker, dead-node, easing, boundaries, byte layout, purity); all four claimed fail-fast classes covered (missing-key, amber 0, negative leads, lead 0); P1 gaps none; remaining gaps are P3 (panel fallback, HUD legend, pulse unit math).
recommended_fix: Close the P3 gaps with the panel-fallback unit pin and a pulse_factor table-math pin to reach full traceability.
